purpose: Measure whether reader-facing HTML surfaces feel inhabited rather than merely navigational, and drive a systematic enrichment programme.
thesis: The project is not poor in knowledge; it is poor where backend knowledge fails to become authored public substance. Richness means useful density, concrete explanation and lived specificity—not card count, route count or schema exposure.

minimum_experience: orientation: what this page is and why it matters
substance: at least one concrete explanation rather than category labels alone
specificity: named objects, dates, mechanisms, works, cases, evidence or claims owned by the page
development: what changes over time or across states
boundary: what the page does not establish
depth: routes into actual canonical holdings or sources
continuity: links that feel like conceptual continuation rather than a generic footer
preferred_editorial_forms: tables only where comparison genuinely benefits
anti_patterns: repeated In scope for this bounded context labels
large grids where every card has equal visual weight
generic definitions that could belong to any website
link directories with no explanation of why a reader should care
backend richness that never reaches the public surface
schema-shaped prose that reads like a database record
a page that requires opening JSON or governance files before the subject becomes concrete
automatic backend projection overwriting authored explanation
word-count padding without new objects, mechanisms, evidence or consequences
substance_first_rule: The visible page must teach before it routes.
Authored prose is a first-class materialization target, not decorative copy around backend structure.
A reader should encounter concrete objects, dates, mechanisms, examples, evidence, disputes and consequences before repository architecture.
Backend owners strengthen and correct the page but do not dictate its rhetorical shape.
Machine-readable semantic bonds should be quiet enough that TTS and ordinary reading remain continuous.
Automatic projection may prevent starvation but must never be mistaken for finished editorial substance.

screening_only.rule: File size is triage only. It must never promote content, fail a page by itself, or substitute for editorial review.

authored_section_floor.rule: A registered substance section should contain enough actual prose to teach something. This is a regression floor, not a target; padding does not satisfy the quality contract.

system_fix.effect: Nested Rooms now project dossier purpose, belongs-here scope, canonical holdings, governed interfaces, receives/hands-to routes, unfinished work and public surfaces directly into the room.
system_fix.limitation: Shared projection fixes starvation but not voice. High-value Rooms still benefit from authored Tim/project-specific essays and examples.

enrichment_strategy: Phase 0: substance first — identify the concrete things the reader should leave knowing.
Phase 1: guarantee automatic dossier-driven minimum substance in every nested Room.
Phase 2: author bespoke opening essays and case material for high-value public surfaces.
Phase 3: quietly bind authored sections to canonical owners, Rooms, relation types and evidence classes.
Phase 4: turn featured holdings into human-readable extracts and object/case spotlights rather than filename-only lists.
Phase 5: enrich parent Dwellings and hubs with narrative synthesis instead of scope-card repetition.
Phase 6: use validators to prevent enriched pages regressing into shells while preserving editorial freedom.

substance_first_contract.rule: Presentation / Fruit has editorial freedom; canonical owners provide quiet typed support. Build-time bindings connect them without making backend schema visible or allowing generated copy to overwrite authored prose.
substance_first_contract.materialization_upgrade: A public route is not enough. Important material should become understandable on the frontend itself, while source truth, provenance, relations and revision remain durable behind it.
substance_first_contract.review_model: Backend change can trigger editorial review; it cannot silently rewrite the human-facing synthesis.

visible_layers.visible: primary/secondary public surfaces: prioritize direct reader understanding and authored synthesis
visible_layers.semi_visible: specialist surfaces: may be task-specific, interactive or narrower; do not force homepage-style essays everywhere
visible_layers.invisible: backend-only owners: no page obligation, but should be reachable through bindings/search when they materially support public claims

current_checks: registered substance section retains real plain-text mass
nested Rooms retain shared dossier/holdings projection as a floor
non_goals: requiring every specialist page to be long-form
forcing equal density across all public surfaces
keeping a hand-maintained list of thin pages
